description: 현재 요금제와 최근 7·30일 및 당월 사용량을 한 번에 조회

fixed_sql: with m as (select max(calendar_date) d from ai_personalization.v_customer_month_daily_usage),u as (select user_id,name,round(sum(total_usage_mb) filter(where calendar_date>=m.d-6),1) trailing_7d_usage_mb,round(sum(total_usage_mb) filter(where calendar_date>=m.d-29),1) trailing_30d_usage_mb,round(sum(total_usage_mb) filter(where calendar_month=date_trunc('month',m.d)::date),1) current_month_usage_mb,m.d reference_date from ai_personalization.v_customer_month_daily_usage cross join m where user_id=$1 group by user_id,name,m.d) select p.*,u.trailing_7d_usage_mb,u.trailing_30d_usage_mb,u.current_month_usage_mb,u.reference_date from ai_personalization.v_customer_current_plan p join u using(user_id,name)
